resume_protocol: Fetch latest main SHA and verify whether main moved from the recorded base.
Fetch PR metadata, exact head SHA, changed files/diff, CI status, and this checkpoint before editing.
Treat only committed code with passing tests as completed; never infer completion from chat history.
If main moved, compare and reconcile explicitly; never force-reset or overwrite unverified work.
Keep all v0.4.0 functional changes on this branch until release gate passes.
Never reintroduce broad subtree:true MutationObserver patterns or documentElement-wide observers.
After each completed stage, update this checkpoint with evidence: commit SHA and CI run when available.
product_principle: 首页10秒回答：孩子现在在哪 -> 最近有没有变化 -> 变化来自哪里；再进入具体考试/分数。学生不被审判，家长知道要看什么，老师能快速读懂分享。

S0.name: UI baseline and recovery contract
requirements: Create draft PR early and keep this checkpoint authoritative.
Audit PC/Pad/Android hierarchy from current v0.3.0 code.
Preserve weak-network stability and existing exam-entry performance fixes.

S1.name: Design-system consolidation
requirements: Unify radius tokens to small/medium/large, spacing rhythm, typography hierarchy, focus states and button hierarchy.
Keep current restrained green/neutral palette; do not use red/green as academic judgment.
One primary action per visual region.

S2.name: Homepage hierarchy
requirements: Make school-relative position the largest visual datum; total score becomes supporting context.
First screen order: 现在在哪 -> 最近变化 -> 变化来源 -> 最近考试.
Remove duplicate overview/trajectory summaries and avoid dashboard-card accumulation.

S3.name: Trajectory information architecture
requirements: Overview tells what happened; trajectory explains why.
Keep overall/single-subject/six-subject/time-axis roles distinct.
On mobile, six-subject scan becomes compact rows rather than six oversized cards.
Single-subject history remains complete while only category-compatible exams drive trend conclusions.

S4.name: Human exam-entry semantics
requirements: Use human fields: 考试类型, 考试范围, optional 更多比较信息; hide implementation language such as comparisonSeries from normal users.
Show 联考位次/人数 inside overall position only when relevant; participants remain optional.
Retain two subject cards per row on desktop and one per row on tablet/mobile.

S5.name: Sharing flow redesign
requirements: Default flow: 分享什么 -> 给谁看 -> 隐私摘要 -> 生成并复制链接.
Presets: family, teacher, custom; advanced field checkboxes collapsed by default.
Single-exam share stays pinned; trajectory share keeps multidimensional tabs and touchable timeline.
Family notes/account/member data remain impossible to share.

S6.name: Settings/onboarding simplification
requirements: Turn settings into task navigation: family members, children, invite new family, account recovery, sharing/privacy.
Onboarding becomes staged instead of one dense form; recovery code step requires explicit save acknowledgement.
Do not expose server secrets or admin bootstrap credentials in browser UI.

S7.name: Renderer consolidation and weak-network behavior
requirements: Reduce post-render patching where safe; stable UI should render correctly once rather than visibly morphing on weak networks.
Do not sacrifice the v0.3.0 data/API contract or draft recovery.
No broad DOM observer, no continuous mutation loop, no layout flash that blocks exam entry.

S8.name: Cross-device and accessibility acceptance
requirements: At 360px: no page-level horizontal scroll, main tap targets >=44px, first screen exposes position + recent change.
PC: no more than three primary information zones in the first screen; total score must not dominate relative position.
Sharing should reach a copied link through at most three normal decisions; advanced privacy controls are secondary.
Keyboard focus-visible, touch scrolling, dialog scrolling, weak-network loading and Android regressions covered.

release_gate: S0-S8 marked completed with repository evidence.
Version exactly 0.4.0 across package.json, package-lock.json and wrangler.toml.
npm run verify passes on the final PR head.
UI contract tests cover hierarchy, share flow, responsive/touch rules, observer performance guard and privacy.
Final self-review finds no duplicate legacy UI visible beside v0.4 UI.
PR marked ready only after final head CI success.
Merge with expected_head_sha; then main CI must pass.
Cloudflare deploy must checkout the exact tested main SHA.
Production /api/health must attest appVersion=0.4.0 before declaring completion.
